name: Milady Maker
rootCause: Milady founder Charlotte Fang said that a developer of Milady misappropriated approximately $1 million from the Bonkler treasury of Milady's official project. The developer also seized the code base and asked the team to hand over more funds and NFT reserves. Currently, the Twitter accounts of miladymaker and remilionaire are controlled by this developer. Charlotte Fang said the relevant members have been identified and will be held accountable to the fullest extent of the law. Minting of Bonkler NFTs is temporarily suspended and Bonkler’s community vaults, contracts, and NFTs are safe. Other series of NFTs from Milady parent company Remilia are not affected for the time being.

descriptions.text: Milady founder Charlotte Fang said that a developer of Milady misappropriated approximately $1 million from the Bonkler treasury of Milady's official project. The developer also seized the code base and asked the team to hand over more funds and NFT reserves. Currently, the Twitter accounts of miladymaker and remilionaire are controlled by this developer. Charlotte Fang said the relevant members have been identified and will be held accountable to the fullest extent of the law. Minting of Bonkler NFTs is temporarily suspended and Bonkler’s community vaults, contracts, and NFTs are safe. Other series of NFTs from Milady parent company Remilia are not affected for the time being.

On September 11, 2023, a developer with privileged admin access diverted approximately $1 million in protocol-generated fees from Milady Maker's Bonkler project on Ethereum Mainnet. NFT assets and core reserves remained safe, but operational control and social accounts were seized. Direct admin privilege allowed an internal contractor to reroute Bonkler fee revenue without multisig protection or timelock controls.
